entities.name: Ronom Glacier
entities.description: The coldest part of Terisiare during the Ice Age, the oldest and widest glacier on the continent.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria where the glacier lay.

entities.name: Ronom Lake
entities.description: Lake formed from the glacier's meltwater; became the Frost Marsh in the Ice Age.

entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: Found a mysterious runed cane at the glacier.

entities.name: Yumok
entities.description: People who fished artifacts out of the meltwater.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Foreboding artifact fished from the meltwater.

entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: Mad wizard who awakened frozen Phyrexian war-beasts.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker whose Thaw Heidar hoped to stop.

entities.name: Arcum Dagsson
entities.description: Famed master machinist who trekked to destroy Heidar's constructs.

entities.name: Marit Lage
entities.description: A prison deep within the glacier.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: Spell whose casting began the Flooding of Terisiare.

entities.name: Efuan Pincar
entities.description: Nation that later arose at the glacier's former site.

events.summary: Feldon finds a runed cane buried in the glacier's ice.
events.quote: The Ronom Glacier was the site where Feldon found a mysterious runed cane

events.summary: The Yumok fish up the Coral Helm and Golgothian Sylex from the meltwater.
events.quote: several other artifacts were fished up by the Yumok

events.summary: In the Ice Age the glacier grows, drying its river and turning Ronom Lake into the Frost Marsh.
events.quote: Ronom Lake became the dreaded Frost Marsh

events.summary: Heidar awakens frozen Phyrexian war-beasts to stop Freyalise's Thaw; Arcum Dagsson goes to destroy his army.
events.quote: until the mad wizard Heidar awakened them in the hope he could stop Freyalise 's Thaw .

events.summary: After the World Spell, the glacier melts over decades, creating the Sea of Laments and Sea of Almaaz.
events.quote: Ronom Glacier proceeded to melt rapidly over several decades

relations.quote: The Ronom Glacier was the coldest part of Terisiare during the Ice Age of Dominaria .
He was opposed by the famed master machinist Arcum Dagsson
